set_before: e17_lazy.py had produced no results when this file was written
justification: Half of the 0.010 macro nDCG@10 loss from truncating MiniLM to 128 tokens, and below the 0.007 change in re-ranking nDCG@10 from BM25 parameter changes, both measured in earlier experiments. Known at the time: the earlier comparison of JIT-AF+ANN with Hybrid CC had a 90% interval of -0.0048 to +0.0027, so this margin was not set blind to that one comparison. 0.002 is the earlier non-inferiority bound and is also reported.
